title: EASformer: Environment-Action-State Alignment for Industrial Generative Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.27691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern industrial ranking systems increasingly adopt generative recommendation (GR) paradigms, in which user behavior sequences and non-sequential (NS) features are tokenized and jointly modeled by Transformer-style backbones. This unified formulation provides a scalable interface for modeling long histories and heterogeneous features. However, sequence and NS representations often carry asymmetric semantics: historical representations may combine environment context with observed-action semantics, whereas candidate-side NS representations contain no observed action but incorporate richer supplementary context, such as user-item interaction features and recent behavior lists. Direct interaction between such representations can make query-key dot products compare different semantic objects, limiting meaningful cross-token interaction. translated_title: EASformer：面向工业生成式排序的环境-动作-状态对齐
translated_abstract: 现代工业排序系统正日益采用生成式推荐（GR）范式，其中用户行为序列与非序列（NS）特征被标记化后由Transformer风格的骨干网络联合建模。这种统一的形式化为长历史与异构特征的建模提供了可扩展的接口。然而，序列表示与NS表示往往携带不对称的语义：历史表示可能将环境上下文与已观测动作的语义混合在一起，而候选侧的NS表示虽不含已观测动作，却包含更丰富的补充上下文，例如用户-物品交互特征和近期行为列表。这类表示之间的直接交互会使query-key点积在比较不同的语义对象，从而限制了有意义的跨token交互。为填补这一空白，我们提出了EASformer，一种面向工业生成式排序的环境-动作-状态解耦架构……
tldr: 提出EASformer架构，通过将环境、动作与状态语义解耦并对齐序列与非序列特征之间的不对称语义，解决生成式排序中query-key点积比较异质语义对象、跨token交互受限的问题。
